name: Stats Wire
text:
Kimi K3's open weights drop tonight.

2.8 trillion parameters. The largest open-source model ever released. Kimi API Platform
Everyone is going to say "you can run it locally."

The honest version: you need a minimum of 8× H100 GPUs just to load it. A single RTX 4090 cannot run it even quantized. Explainx

The hype will be loud. The hardware reality will be quiet.
